documents.title: Introduction: AI in Higher Education (CTL AI guidance hub; quotes the University Generative AI Policy)
documents.stance_why: The page sets no university rule itself. It says "instructors and academic departments have the ability to develop their own AI course policies" and offers three sample statements from fully encouraging to "strictly prohibited", so decisions go to instructors and the document is a menu of tiers.
documents.summary: Columbia CTL faculty guidance on writing AI syllabus statements. It recommends every instructor state expectations, supplies three template tiers, and gives advice on integrity reporting, AI detectors and data protection. The official Provost policy was not fetchable, so this page stands in for it.
